author.name: Efficiency Emilia
author.role: Uses deep domain knowledge to define business goals, objectives, and KPIs. Aligns ML features with overarching product strategy and organizational roadmaps. Evaluates system performance, operational capability, and project costs.

challenge.name: The Missing Baseline
challenge.description: The KPI definitions were never formally agreed, leaving the project without a clear target for success. #efficiency_emilia# wants the KPI definition to be fully automated and governed to ensure alignment with business goals, while #requirements_reuben# argues it should remain a manual process to allow for careful security and compliance review. #efficiency_emilia# is open to a compromise that keeps the process manual but documented, but #requirements_reuben# insists on strict manual control.

output.content: I am willing to drop my request for fully automated and governed KPI definitions. I can accept that the process remains manual and under human control. In exchange, I need the manual steps to be rigorously documented so that every decision is traceable and aligned with our business goals. This trade gives up the speed and consistency of automation, but it secures the clarity I need to evaluate system performance against our strategic objectives. I am not asking for a hybrid system. I am asking for a clear, auditable manual path that satisfies both operational needs and compliance requirements without sacrificing the integrity of our metrics.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to give up the speed and consistency of automation in exchange for a rigorously documented manual process that ensures traceability and alignment with business goals.
